about_the_game:
Unlock Your Thrill with EA Play

Whether you’re electrifying the Prem in EA SPORTS FC™, holding the frontline in the Battlefield™ series, or driving for victory in Madden NFL, EA Play lets you experience the world of EA—playing more of the games you love or discovering your next favorite.

What’s included with your membership:

The Play List - Enjoy unlimited access to a collection of EA’s fan-favorite franchises and top titles. From iconic series to fresh hits, there’s always something ready to play.

Game Trials - Try select new releases for up to 10 hours with no commitment. If you decide to buy, your progress carries over to the full game, so you can pick up right where you left off.

Member Rewards - Unlock member rewards in the hottest EA titles each month.

10% Discount - Score 10% off EA digital purchases, including game downloads, Season Passes, points packs, and DLC.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 98/ME/2000/XP/Vista
  • Processor: 1.2GHz+ processor
  • Memory: 256 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 128MB of video memory, 16-bit or 32-bit color quality
  • DirectX: Version 7.0
  • Storage: 65 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound
  • Additional Notes: Note: the above requirements are for the least demanding game included in your EA Play membership.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 2700X, Intel Core i7 4790
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT, Nvidia GeForce RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Sound Card: No recommendation
  • Additional Notes: Note: the above requirements are for the most demanding game included in your EA Play membership.
